title: Toolbar heatmap URL edit rules: data_url is editable at resource level, url/render settings stay locked
answers: Why can't an object-level editor change a heatmap's data URL?
Can I edit the data URL of a toolbar-captured heatmap?
PATCH saved heatmap returns 403 when changing url or data_url
body:
Rules for SavedHeatmap partial updates:
- Toolbar-source heatmaps: `partial_update` in products/web_analytics/backend/api/heatmaps_api.py only treats `url` and `block_consent_modals` as render inputs (rejected with ValidationError). `data_url` is NOT a render input, so it can change without replacing the screenshot/snapshots or enqueuing a render.
- Object-only editors must never retarget `url` or `data_url` (either source). Aggregate-query scoping (HeatmapAggregateQueryScopingPermission) matches url_exact against heatmaps the caller has object grants on, so retargeting would widen data access. Test: test_heatmap_access_control.py::test_object_level_editor_cannot_retarget_heatmap_url (parameterized over source/field).
- Frontend mirror: `dataUrlEditDisabledReason` in products/web_analytics/frontend/heatmaps/scenes/heatmap/heatmapLogic.ts requires resource-level Heatmap editor access; `urlEditDisabledReason` and `renderSettingsEditDisabledReason` still lock toolbar captures. HeatmapPageFields.tsx uses the data URL one for the data URL input.
- Keep backend and frontend gating in sync when changing either.
applies: SavedHeatmap PATCH endpoint and the heatmap page settings UI in products/web_analytics
